# Acme Web engineering guide

## Commands

Feature flags are read through the flags service and default to off. API handlers validate input with the schema library and return typed errors. Never commit generated files under dist or build directories. When adding a dependency, explain the alternative you rejected in the PR.

- Feature flags are read through the flags service and default to off.
- Error messages are written for the on-call engineer at three in the morning.

## Architecture

Public functions carry doc comments describing units and failure modes. Error messages are written for the on-call engineer at three in the morning. When adding a dependency, explain the alternative you rejected in the PR. Keep React components under two hundred lines and extract hooks early.

- Error messages are written for the on-call engineer at three in the morning.
- Do not mock the database in integration tests; use the disposable container.
